job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is a Missouri LAGERS private-market consulting RFP, not the SBCERS global custody RFP. Its evaluation section does not provide the four requested categories or their percentage weights.
quotes: Missouri Local Government Employees Retirement System (LAGERS) is issuing this Request for Proposal (RFP) for the purpose of soliciting qualified firms to provide private market consulting services.
Evaluation Criteria Providers will be evaluated based on their written responses to this Proposal.
LAGERS reserves the right to consider additional criteria not presented here.
